findings: VERIFIED (prior-criticism closure, this commit): every accepted finding of the early REQUEST_CHANGES direction review is implemented in the merged source. campaign_pipeline.execute with complete_negative_review preserves REVISE/REQUEST_CHANGES as REVISION_REQUIRED with exact review_completion_policy/review_verdict/acceptance_status bindings; hosted_campaign_task.completed_pipeline accepts and re-validates that negative outcome while reviewed_proposal still refuses to adopt it; handover_runtime._bookkeep_campaign carries the unchanged verdict and criticism into an attributed disposition record without inventing a report review. change_requests.context makes REQUEST_CHANGES sticky per applied event (outcomes.get(identity) != 'REQUEST_CHANGES' guard) with explicit supersedes_applied_events starting PENDING, and _bounded_context keeps growing history under 20000 bytes with honest omitted_review_status_counts. scientific_authority.seal/_create_original/stage_context validate judgment and review preconditions before any exclusive write and map races to the named SCIENTIFIC_AUTHORITY_ORIGINAL_EXISTS_RECONCILE refusal. completion_bridge.ingest clears only the resolved COMPLETION_IDENTITY_CHANGED warning on the prior-and-matching path and preserves unrelated evidence blocks. controller_command threads the caller-supplied config path. Runtime.admit orders broker admission before finalized publication, and research packets are PRIVATE_ONLY on the LIVE path. All are exercised by the supplied focused tests.

VERIFIED (installer identity bindings, this commit): deploy/research-system/install_live_research.py binds the exact source review (scope human-controls, reviewed_commit == source, verdict APPROVE, requested_model and assistant_message_models claude-fable-5, request/response/execution hash chain), the archive bytes via verified_archive, the executing checkout via checked_source(executing_root, source) plus byte-equality of every REQUIRED_SOURCE helper, regenerated plan() equality for every generated broker/controller/unit/wrapper byte, the pinned CONFIG_HASHES for both preserved configurations, and the exact ledger pin/state. reviewed_private_inputs additionally requires the actual review request's private_evidence_sha256 to cover the proposal, research evidence and all five generated files; the supplied private evidence is consistent (proposal.json file_sha256 values match the supplied generated bytes; research-evidence.json 3e8577f2... matches the controller research_request and request.json; broker sources include both 04d67a00... and 9638264a...; live_configuration 325cca0f... matches CONFIG_HASHES and the observed installed bytes).

VERIFIED (fail-closed recovery semantics): recovery_state refuses intent-without-receipt as PARTIAL_INSTALL_PRESERVED_RECONCILE and validates the original receipt's zero-model/zero-activation fields; a completed duplicate re-verifies installed bytes, modes and owners and returns the original receipt with restart_performed false; idle() requires a running single-process idle broker, empty live turn directory, inactive controller and only-COMPLETE coordinator tasks before any mutation; every failure path writes install-failure.json with automatic_retry false and preserves originals. The staging flock prevents concurrent installs, and baseline/ledger are re-checked immediately before the unit replacement and again after restart.

VERIFIED (scientific approvals and stops preserved): one installed research task with three fixed model stages; SUPERVISED max_model_turns=1 with duplicate-safe shared admission (repeat stage admissions are duplicates, not new counts); submit_research records saved work atomically with zero model calls and zero admissions and returns the identical task on resubmission or restart, refusing changed inputs with RESEARCH_REQUEST_IDENTITY_CONFLICT or RESEARCH_INPUT_BINDING_CHANGED before any broker call; pause blocks admission while preserving inspectable state; the existing campaign human-stop check blocks the shared pipeline; negative reviews cannot become adoptions; the generated wrapper's propose route is submission-only with declared (not attested) ssh-uid:0 attribution and literal argument transport; no timer, limiter reset, credential change or unattended-activation path is introduced.

DISAGREEMENT RESOLUTION (verified against kernel/systemd semantics; deployed connect untested): the earlier inferred blocker that ProtectSystem=strict without a /run ReadWritePaths entry would break the controller's AF_UNIX connect is incorrect as written — read-only mounts deny MAY_WRITE only for regular files, directories and symlinks; S_ISSOCK inodes are exempt, so connect() to /run/research-system/handover-live.sock from the strict, PrivateNetwork controller unit is expected to succeed. The preserved disagreement and strict unit are appropriate. The actual deployed connect remains acceptance evidence to observe on the host, not an assumption.

SUGGESTION (availability only, non-blocking): coordinator stage receipts are written through operations_report.immutable, whose public-text bound is 100000 bytes, while broker replies may be up to 1.5 MB; a continuation/disposition answer near or above ~99 KB would fail the receipt write, and recovery would re-fail on the same bound, leaving the task permanently BLOCKED although the broker originals persist. Campaign stages are capped at 80000 bytes in BrokerStages.call, so only the non-campaign and disposition answers are exposed. Smallest correction: write stage receipts with the 1.5 MB private immutable (hosted_cycle) or cap answers at the broker for all stages.

SUGGESTION (cosmetic, fail-closed): install_live_research raises an unnamed AttributeError when manifest['source_input_sha256'] names an archive member absent from the snapshot (extractfile returns None before .read()); the __main__ handler converts it to the generic INSTALL_FAILED reason. A named refusal before reading would keep operator diagnostics uniform. No incorrect acceptance is possible on this path.
